description.value: Sawmill TapHouse and Grill has been a Chemainus dining staple since 2017, celebrated for its forno oven pizzas, slow-cooked smoked meats, and rotating Pacific Northwest craft beer taps. Described by Traveler's Island as 'really nothing quite like it in the Cowichan Valley,' the restaurant blends an urban vibe with local Chemainus history in a family-friendly atmosphere. The kitchen accommodates a range of dietary needs and offers on-site takeout, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through.
